sentences.en: Layla and Sami held hands and walked along the corridor.
sentences.zh: 莱拉和萨米牵着手在走廊里走。

sentences.en: I happened to witness the bullying in the corridor.
sentences.zh: 我恰好目睹了走廊里的欺凌事件。

sentences.en: The corridor was so crowded that we couldn't walk.
sentences.zh: 走廊里人太多了，我们根本无法通行。

senses.zh: 走廊，通道,走廊（一国领土通过他国境内的狭长地带）,建覆道
